root.name: バーテックス・ファーマシューティカルズ

companies.name: クリスパー・セラピューティクス

relations.text: 鎌状赤血球症などの治療薬CASGEVYを、共同で開発・販売する契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: Vertex has a joint development and commercialization agreement with CRISPR to co-develop and co-commercialize CASGEVY for SCD and TDT

source.label: バーテックス・ファーマシューティカルズ 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In 2017, we entered into a joint development and commercialization agreement (“Original JDCA”) with CRISPR Therapeutics AG (“CRISPR”), pursuant to which we are co-developing and co-commercializing CASGEVY for SCD and TDT

relations.text: CASGEVYの純損益は、自社60%、CRISPR 40%で配分される
relations.text_en: Net profits and losses on CASGEVY are split 60% to Vertex and 40% to CRISPR

source.label: バーテックス・ファーマシューティカルズ 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: The net profits and net losses incurred pursuant to the A&R JDCA with respect to CASGEVY are allocated 60% to us and 40% to CRISPR, subject to certain adjustments

relations.text: 嚢胞性線維症向けのmRNA治療薬を探す共同研究を、モデルナと進めている
relations.text_en: Vertex collaborates with Moderna on mRNA therapeutics encoding CFTR for cystic fibrosis

source.label: バーテックス・ファーマシューティカルズ 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In 2016, we entered into a collaboration with Moderna for the identification and development of mRNA therapeutics encoding CFTR for the treatment of CF.

relations.text: 1型糖尿病の細胞治療薬の製造を、ロンザが支える戦略契約がある
relations.text_en: Lonza supports manufacture of Vertex's T1D cell therapy candidates under a strategic agreement

source.label: バーテックス・ファーマシューティカルズ 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: we have a strategic agreement with Lonza to support the manufacture of T1D cell therapy product candidates

relations.text: povetaciceptをアジアの市場で開発・販売するため、ザイ・ラボと契約した
relations.text_en: Vertex entered into an agreement with Zai Lab for development and commercialization of povetacicept in certain Asian markets

source.label: バーテックス・ファーマシューティカルズ 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In 2025, we entered into agreements with Zai Lab Limited (“Zai”) and Ono Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd (“Ono”) related to the development and commercialization of povetacicept in certain Asian markets

relations.text: povetaciceptをアジアの市場で開発・販売するため、小野薬品と契約した
relations.text_en: Vertex entered into an agreement with Ono for development and commercialization of povetacicept in certain Asian markets

source.label: バーテックス・ファーマシューティカルズ 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In 2025, we entered into agreements with Zai Lab Limited (“Zai”) and Ono Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd (“Ono”) related to the development and commercialization of povetacicept in certain Asian markets

companies.name: エディタス・メディスン

relations.text: CRISPR/Cas9の特許について、エディタスから非独占の再実施権を得た
relations.text_en: Vertex obtained a non-exclusive sublicense from Editas to certain CRISPR/Cas9 patents

source.label: バーテックス・ファーマシューティカルズ 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In December 2023, we entered into an agreement with Editas Medicine, Inc. (“Editas”), providing us a non-exclusive sublicense to certain patents relating to CRISPR/Cas9 technology

companies.name: エントラーダ・セラピューティクス

relations.text: 提携先のエントラーダに、マイルストーン支払いを行った
relations.text_en: Vertex made a milestone payment to its collaborator Entrada

source.label: バーテックス・ファーマシューティカルズ 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Most of these collaboration payments are expensed as AIPR&D, including, a $75.0 million milestone paid to Entrada in 2024
